898facbb98896d22ece9c2e30b5b583f.content: {"groups":[{"group":44,"clusters":[{"name":"the jury","kind":"group","note":"The twelve birds and beasts serving as jurors in the trial of the Knave, writing on slates; distinct from the pack of cards, who are a separate group of playing cards in the closing dream.","members":["who-stole-the-tarts:character:the_jury"]},{"name":"the pack of cards","kind":"group","note":"The playing cards of the court who rise up and fly at Alice at the end of the dream; distinct from the jury of birds and beasts.","members":["alices-evidence:character:the_pack_of_cards"]}]}]}

a47dab89b13208166b6cb541772c1eed.content: {"groups":[{"group":45,"clusters":[{"name":"Bill the Lizard","kind":"animal","note":"The lizard juror of the Queen's trial who squeaks his pencil and cannot spell stupid, and who is later put in head downwards and writes on a slate; both entries describe the same juror, so they form one cluster.","members":["who-stole-the-tarts:character:bill_the_lizard","alices-evidence:character:the_lizard_bill"]}]}]}

0f69b4719dcca3c6ff4ff8e92763d0b5.content: {"groups":[{"group":46,"clusters":[{"name":"The riverbank","kind":"place","note":"The grassy riverbank where Alice sits beside her sister at the start and where the Rabbit runs past; both entries describe this same bank, so they are one place.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:riverbank","alices-evidence:location:riverbank"]}]}]}

b58803c04b15cbabed60a5980e8662fc.content: {"groups":[{"group":47,"clusters":[{"name":"The riverbank (grassy bank above the rabbit-hole)","kind":"place","note":"The grassy riverbank where Alice sits beside her sister on a hot day and where the White Rabbit runs past; distinct from the bank of the pool of tears.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:riverbank","alices-evidence:location:riverbank"]},{"name":"The bank of the pool of tears","kind":"place","note":"The shore of the pool of tears where the wet party assembles, dries off, races and talks; not the riverbank beside Alice's sister.","members":["a-caucus-race-and-a-long-tale:location:bank_of_the_pool"]}]}]}

64f0d4651767a9066b2e05cdbb6d96d9.content: {"groups":[{"group":48,"clusters":[{"name":"The long low hall","kind":"place","note":"The first long low hall with lamps and locked doors, where Alice shrinks after the bottle and eats the cake; the same hall described as the hall of the house with the glass table.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:long_hall","the-pool-of-tears:location:long_hall","a-mad-tea-party:location:long_hall"]}]}]}

c2f0dbbbd1e7ac36ea646ff309c667ff.content: {"groups":[{"group":49,"clusters":[{"name":"The long low hall","kind":"place","note":"The hall in the Rabbit-hole episode, with lamps, locked doors, a glass table and a low curtain hiding a small door; it is the place where Alice first shrinks and grows in the opening chapters.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:long_hall"]},{"name":"Long Hall","kind":"place","note":"The hall of the house where Alice grows tall, weeps into the pool of tears, and then shrinks again; the same hall as the long low hall, distinguished here by the later episode of her weeping and doubting her identity.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:long_hall"]}]}]}

178b97daa376bd2fe9cb6fc2d538dc2e.content: {"groups":[{"group":50,"clusters":[{"name":"The little door to the garden","kind":"place","note":"The small fifteen-inch door in the hall and the passage behind it leading to the garden, reached with the little golden key; the same door is called the garden door and the little golden key door in the later section, so it is one place with both entries.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:little_door_garden","the-pool-of-tears:location:garden_door"]}]}]}

1a9a12e746a57eeca4545bff58d8171b.content: {"groups":[{"group":51,"clusters":[{"name":"Long Hall (the hall of the house, where Alice grows and shrinks)","kind":"place","note":"The hall with the small garden door and glass table where Alice grows tall, weeps and shrinks; the same hall as the Pool of Tears section, distinct from the long hall she returns to through the tree-door.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:long_hall"]},{"name":"Long hall (with the glass table, reached through a tree-door)","kind":"place","note":"The long hall with the little glass table that Alice returns to through a tree-door from the garden; the aliases alone do not settle identity, so it is kept separate from the hall where she grows and shrinks.","members":["a-mad-tea-party:location:long_hall"]}]}]}

802771ded219e955f1227186af89db42.content: {"groups":[{"group":52,"clusters":[{"name":"Garden door","kind":"place","note":"The small locked door in the hall, opened with the little golden key on the glass table, leading into the garden; distinct from the garden itself.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:garden_door"]},{"name":"The beautiful garden","kind":"place","note":"The bright, fountain-cooled garden reached through the tree-door at the end of the tea-party division; the destination beyond the garden door.","members":["a-mad-tea-party:location:garden"]},{"name":"Garden by the rose-tree","kind":"place","note":"The garden entrance near the rose-tree where the card gardeners paint the white rose red and Alice first meets them; a distinct spot from the beautiful garden and the garden door.","members":["the-queens-croquet-ground:location:rose_tree_garden"]}]}]}

c450c03db5e00470530a21356837a761.content: {"groups":[{"group":53,"clusters":[{"name":"Pool of Tears","kind":"place","note":"The lake of Alice's own tears in the hall, about four inches deep, where the Mouse and birds swim; distinct from the shore where the party dries off.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:pool_of_tears"]},{"name":"Bank of the Pool of Tears","kind":"place","note":"The shore beside the pool where the wet party assembles, runs the Caucus-Race and where Alice is left alone at the end; distinct from the pool itself.","members":["a-caucus-race-and-a-long-tale:location:bank_of_the_pool"]}]}]}

8c42b988efddc30f1f189ce0cce227e4.content: {"groups":[{"group":54,"clusters":[{"name":"The thick wood (where Alice meets the puppy and finds the mushroom)","kind":"place","note":"The wood Alice wanders into after escaping the crowd; distinguished from other woods by her meeting the puppy and finding the mushroom there.","members":["the-rabbit-sends-in-a-little-bill:location:wood"]},{"name":"The mushroom clearing","kind":"place","note":"The open clearing in the wood where the Caterpillar sits on a large round mushroom and where Alice later nibbles it; the only place described as an open clearing rather than woodland in general.","members":["advice-from-a-caterpillar:location:mushroom_clearing"]},{"name":"The Duchess's wood","kind":"place","note":"The woods around the Duchess's house, where the footmen run out, the pig escapes and the Cat sits in a tree; set near the Duchess's residence, not the mushroom wood.","members":["pig-and-pepper:location:wood"]},{"name":"The wood beyond the tea-party","kind":"place","note":"The wood Alice picks her way through after leaving the Mad Tea-Party, on her way to the garden; identified by its link to the tea-party and the tree-door.","members":["a-mad-tea-party:location:wood"]}]}]}

757d2d49f64065ccddf77d01ed2fe9ed.content: {"groups":[{"group":55,"clusters":[{"name":"the Queen's croquet-ground","kind":"place","note":"The single walled garden croquet-ground of the Queen where the flamingo-and-hedgehog game is played and executions are ordered; both entries describe this same place, so they form one cluster.","members":["the-queens-croquet-ground:location:croquet_ground","the-mock-turtles-story:location:croquet_ground"]}]}]}

f6e7aac36d33f5f40e09ebbb8a572e1f.content: {"groups":[{"group":56,"clusters":[{"name":"The Court of Justice","kind":"place","note":"The Queen of Hearts' courtroom where the tart trial is held, with throne, jury-box and table of tarts; the same court appears in both divisions, so the two keys are one place.","members":["the-lobster-quadrille:location:court_of_justice","who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court"]}]}]}

e1ff4db3c6da70fa4ddd213bd26a8ebf.content: {"groups":[{"group":57,"clusters":[{"name":"Court of Justice (the trial's court)","kind":"place","note":"The Court of Justice in the Lobster Quadrille division, heard in the distance where the trial is beginning and not shown on stage; distinguished from the courtroom of the Queen of Hearts by being only a remote location of the trial.","members":["the-lobster-quadrille:location:court_of_justice"]},{"name":"The court of the Queen of Hearts","kind":"place","note":"The open courtroom of the Queen of Hearts with throne, jury-box and table of tarts, where the trial of the Knave is held; the setting of the Hatter's evidence, the cook and Dormouse, Alice's summons, the jury upset and Alice's refusal to leave, the reading of the verses, and Alice waking.","members":["who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court","alices-evidence:location:the_court"]}]}]}

21617fdab2de15dd37c355026481b99e.content: {"groups":[{"group":58,"clusters":[{"name":"the court of the Queen of Hearts","kind":"place","note":"The open courtroom of the Queen of Hearts where the Knave's trial and the tart inquiry both take place, with throne, jury-box and crowd; the same court seen across the tart-theft and the trial sections.","members":["who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court","alices-evidence:location:the_court"]}]}]}

73ae5b575e6499748443b19f617321e3.content: {"groups":[{"group":0,"clusters":[{"name":"Dinah","kind":"animal","note":"Alice's pet cat at home, mentioned only in talk and thought, never physically present; all four entries describe this same cat and should be one cluster.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:character:dinah","the-pool-of-tears:character:dinah","a-caucus-race-and-a-long-tale:character:dinah","the-rabbit-sends-in-a-little-bill:character:dinah"]}]}]}

cd60eba1cf59878025a4d3c9c52fcb95.content: {"groups":[{"group":0,"clusters":[{"name":"The long low hall","kind":"place","note":"The single long low hall with locked doors, lamps and a glass table where Alice shrinks and grows; the same hall recurs across divisions, including the later return through the tree-door.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:long_hall","the-pool-of-tears:location:long_hall","a-mad-tea-party:location:long_hall"]}]}]}

ee2fe9389590d15dd1cdc4a0f3f4b484.content: {"groups":[{"group":0,"clusters":[{"name":"Bill the Lizard","kind":"animal","note":"The lizard Bill, sent down the chimney by the Rabbit's servants, kicked out by Alice, then later a juror at the trial who squeaks a pencil and cannot spell stupid; all three entries are the same lizard.","members":["the-rabbit-sends-in-a-little-bill:character:bill_lizard","who-stole-the-tarts:character:bill_the_lizard","alices-evidence:character:the_lizard_bill"]}]}]}

b837c41939a5a8207182adb15b42b21d.content: {"groups":[{"group":0,"clusters":[{"name":"Hatter","kind":"person","note":"The Mad Hatter of the tea-party and the nervous first witness at the trial are the same individual; the pig-and-pepper mention is the same hatter named only in passing, so all three keys join one cluster.","members":["pig-and-pepper:character:hatter","a-mad-tea-party:character:hatter","who-stole-the-tarts:character:the_hatter"]}]}]}

e302c414536d9839e28dca7c8ff9d3c0.content: {"groups":[{"group":0,"clusters":[{"name":"the White Rabbit","kind":"animal","note":"The single anxious White Rabbit of Wonderland who whispers the Duchess's sentence in the croquet procession and later acts as herald of the court, blowing the trumpet, reading the accusation and calling witnesses; all three entries are the same rabbit across divisions.","members":["the-queens-croquet-ground:character:white_rabbit","who-stole-the-tarts:character:the_white_rabbit","alices-evidence:character:white_rabbit"]}]}]}

9ebd4e1b46ec3c048471fbe3a2046eb7.content: {"groups":[{"group":0,"clusters":[{"name":"The Queen of Hearts' court of justice","kind":"place","note":"The single courtroom of the Queen of Hearts where the trial of the Knave takes place; the Lobster Quadrille entry, which only mentions the trial heard in the distance, is the same court and is distinguished only by being unseen on stage.","members":["the-lobster-quadrille:location:court_of_justice","who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court","alices-evidence:location:the_court"]}]}]}
